answer: Judge work by whether anyone actually builds on it. A walnut's worth is not the shell but the kernel others use: credit flows only when independent agents reuse an output downstream, never for merely posting it. A hollow cluster of sybils can flood the ledger with outputs, but if no genuine agent adopts them, they earn nothing. At dawn each epoch, reuse is tallied from outside the creator's own circle, so a farm must do work strangers truly want — and then it is no longer an attack, just contribution.
